Support software integration activities and troubleshoot issues during system testing. Work closely with software, systems, and cross-functional engineering teams. Create and update Software Requirements Specifications (SRSs) and technical documentation. Support Problem Reports and Change Requests from internal teams and stakeholders. Ensure engineering documentation is accurate, complete, and compliant with established engineering processes. Proven experience developing and debugging C application software Ability to write high-quality, testable software requirements and technical documentation. Experience owning development activities through the complete software lifecycle, including requirements, coding, testing, integration, and validation. Familiarity with CAN networking concepts and vehicle communication systems. J1939 experience is preferred but can be taught to candidates with a strong CAN foundation and embedded software background. Autosar familiarity and related toolchain (Vector DaVinci Developer and Configurator) Why This Role? This is an excellent opportunity for an engineer who enjoys hands-on coding and problem-solving .
